tasks.short: Answer managers' questions and train them on interviewing, appraisals, difficult talks and documenting performance issues.

steps.what: Take manager questions on interviews, appraisals and underperformance by mail or Teams

loop.input: manager question in Teams plus the policy library on SharePoint (HR guides, CAO texts, appraisal cycle, templates)
loop.output: answer with links to the source paragraphs, or an escalation ticket to the HRBP
loop.check: answer must cite at least one approved source; questions that name a person, a case or dismissal always escalate
loop.stop: one retrieval and answer pass; no source found or personal case means escalate to the HRBP queue
loop.why_not_simpler: managers ask in free text and the answer sits across CAO, policy and templates; a FAQ page alone is not used

steps.what: Look up policy, CAO rules and templates on SharePoint and AFAS
Prepare training material, guidance notes and documentation templates

loop.input: topic, audience (warehouse team lead or office manager), policy extract and the house template
loop.output: slide deck, one-page guide and practice cases in Dutch
loop.check: HRBP reviews for legal accuracy against CAO and Dutch dismissal rules before publishing
loop.stop: one draft plus at most two revisions; else HRBP writes it
loop.why_not_simpler: content must be adapted per audience and topic; fixed templates cover only the layout

steps.what: Run training sessions and one-to-one coaching on difficult conversations
Check managers document performance issues correctly in the personnel file

tasks.design: A Copilot Studio answer desk in Teams answers managers' general questions from the approved SharePoint policy and CAO library, says it is AI, and opens a ticket to the HRBP for anything about a named person. A drafting step builds training kits and guides from house templates for HRBP review, and a Power Automate checklist on the AFAS performance file reminds managers of missing steps in an improvement plan (meeting notes, signed plan, review dates).
tasks.previous_blocker: Policy answers depended on the HRBP knowing where everything sat; chatbots before 2023 could not read free-text questions against long policy texts well enough.
tasks.enabler_now: Retrieval over owned SharePoint content with source citations is a configurable product feature, and drafting Dutch training material is cheap; IBM and Coca-Cola Andina run such front doors at scale.
tasks.still_hard: Keeping the policy library current and correct; managers trusting the answers; the coaching itself and the judgement in a performance case.
tasks.human_edge: Coaching a team lead through a first hard conversation with a long-serving warehouse worker, and judging when a performance issue is really an absence or personal problem.

ambition.what: Short just-in-time guidance for the roughly 60 shift and team leads in the warehouses, who now rarely get HR training.

tasks.altitude: The HRBP spends less time on repeat questions and more on the escalated cases and coaching; they decide which guidance goes into the library and when a case needs their direct involvement.

reach.task: Building manager training paths in Studytube
reach.learn: How to turn the guidance notes into short modules and track completion.

reach.task: Maintaining personnel file records in AFAS
reach.learn: Which file items make a performance dossier complete for UWV or the kantonrechter.

evidence.claim: IBM's Ask HR front door handles over 11 million interactions a year with HRBPs as second line for escalated complex cases.
Coca-Cola Andina's HR agent serves 1,200 of 3,600 staff monthly and raises tickets for what it cannot answer.
Employee-facing bots must disclose they are AI.
Works council consent is needed for systems that process personnel data or can observe performance.
Average time saved by HR professionals using chatbots is about 3% of hours.
Copilot Studio can answer from SharePoint content inside Teams.

assumptions: Policies, CAO texts and templates are on SharePoint in a usable state.
Noordhaven has Microsoft 365 licences that allow Copilot Studio.
Warehouse team leads have Teams on a phone or shared device.
unknowns: How many manager questions per month reach the three HRBPs, and how many are general versus about a named person.
Whether the OR has an existing agreement on AI tools or Copilot.
Whether performance files are kept in AFAS, SharePoint or managers' own mail.
research_questions: What share of last quarter's manager questions could be answered from existing policy documents alone?
Do warehouse team leads actually use Teams during a shift?
Will the OR treat the file checklist as performance monitoring that needs consent under WOR art. 27(1)(l)?

tasks.short: Design ways to track employee satisfaction and run grievance and complaint procedures, with the works council.

steps.what: Collect signals from exit talks, complaints, absence and OR feedback
Draft survey design or grievance procedure text

loop.input: current procedure, CAO clauses, SER advice and the signal overview
loop.output: draft procedure or survey questions with a list of choices for the OR
loop.check: HRBP and HR director review; a checklist confirms an anonymous route, response times and an appeal option
loop.stop: one draft plus two revisions; the HRBP finishes it by hand after that
loop.why_not_simpler: each procedure is new text fitted to Noordhaven's sites and CAO; templates give only the skeleton

steps.what: Consult works council and management on the method
Set up the survey and track complaints in Forms and Excel

tasks.design: Replace the complaint mailbox and Excel list with a restricted SharePoint grievance register fed by a Microsoft Forms intake, with Power Automate routing, response-time reminders and an appeal step. A Power BI page on the nightly AFAS extract combines absence, turnover and register counts per site, with a minimum group size so nobody is identifiable; a bounded drafting step helps write the procedure and survey for OR review.
tasks.previous_blocker: Signals sat in separate mailboxes, AFAS and notes, and nobody owned joining them; drafting procedures was slow work done rarely.
tasks.enabler_now: Power BI already runs on the AFAS extract, and Forms, SharePoint lists and Power Automate are in the existing Microsoft 365 licence; drafting help makes procedure text fast.
tasks.still_hard: Trust that complaints stay confidential, OR consent, small sites where anonymity breaks, and special-category data in complaints.
tasks.human_edge: Agreeing the method with the OR and building trust that warehouse and flex workers can complain without consequences.

ambition.what: A complaint and pulse route open to the 150 to 300 agency flex workers, who today fall outside HR's channels.

tasks.altitude: The HRBP sees satisfaction signals per site each month instead of once a year, and decides with the OR when to act on a hotspot.

reach.task: Building Power BI HR dashboards on the AFAS extract
reach.learn: How to set minimum group sizes and join register data without exposing individuals.
What the WOR art. 27 consent request for a monitoring tool must contain.

evidence.claim: Works council consent is required before tools that process personnel data or can observe behaviour.
Councils are often involved only after go-live.
People affected by an AI outcome must always be able to complain.
Text sentiment analysis of employee messages is monitoring that needs consent.
Forms, SharePoint lists and Power Automate can run an intake and routing workflow.

assumptions: The nightly AFAS extract includes absence and exits per department.
There is an existing complaint procedure (CAO or company) to start from.
No sentiment analysis of Teams or mail is used.
unknowns: How many grievances per year arrive and through which channels.
Whether agency flex workers may use Noordhaven's procedure or must go through their agency.
Smallest department size per site, to set the anonymity threshold.
research_questions: Would the OR consent to a central grievance register, and on what access rules?
Does any department fall below ten people, breaking anonymous reporting?
Do the three staffing agencies' contracts allow Noordhaven to survey flex workers directly?

tasks.short: Build reports and slides on employee satisfaction and related data for management and the works council.

steps.what: Export survey results and AFAS absence and turnover data
Clean, aggregate and compare scores per site and department
Read and group free-text comments into themes

loop.input: anonymised survey comments for groups of ten or more
loop.output: theme per comment from a fixed list, plus 'other', with counts per site
loop.check: HRBP checks a sample of 30 and all 'other'; names and identifying details are stripped before and after
loop.stop: one pass per comment; low-confidence comments go to 'other' for the HRBP
loop.why_not_simpler: comments are free Dutch text; keyword rules miss most themes

steps.what: Write narrative and build slides for MT and OR

loop.input: satisfaction tables, comment themes and last period's report
loop.output: draft slides and a one-page summary with changes since last period
loop.check: every number traces to the Power BI table; HRBP edits conclusions and actions
loop.why_not_simpler: the narrative must explain changes in words; the table layout itself is fixed and generated without a model

steps.what: Present results and agree actions with management and OR

tasks.design: A scheduled job loads survey and register data next to the nightly AFAS extract into Power BI, which produces the site and department tables with a minimum group size. A bounded model step themes anonymised comments, and a report generator fills the house PowerPoint template with tables and a draft narrative for the HRBP to edit before the MT and OR meeting.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each report was a one-off Excel job; reading hundreds of comments by hand was the slowest part and could not be scripted.
tasks.enabler_now: Power BI on AFAS already exists, and models can theme Dutch free text reliably enough for a reviewed first pass.
tasks.still_hard: Keeping anonymity in small groups, explaining causes rather than numbers, and handling bad news with managers.
tasks.human_edge: Deciding what the numbers mean for a site and which two actions to push with management and the OR.

ambition.what: Quarterly instead of yearly satisfaction review per site, linked to verzuim and 90-day retention.

tasks.altitude: The HRBP stops building spreadsheets and spends the time on the follow-up with site managers; they choose which findings go to the MT.

reach.task: Maintaining the HR Power BI model
reach.learn: How to add survey data with anonymity rules to the existing model.
How finance automates commentary on variances, to reuse the pattern.

evidence.claim: Satisfaction reporting suits dashboards plus a model step over comments.
Works council consent is needed when personnel data is processed by AI.
Workday HRBPs built narrow agents that cut preparation time, though value was hard to prove.
Employees can react badly to text they see as AI-written.

assumptions: A satisfaction survey with free-text comments is run at least yearly.
Power BI licences cover the HRBPs and the people analyst.
Comments can be processed by a model inside the Microsoft tenant.
unknowns: Which survey tool is used and whether it has an export or API.
How many comments a survey produces.
Whether the OR receives the full report or a summary.
research_questions: Does themed output on last year's comments match what the HRBP found by hand on a sample?
Can the survey be run quarterly without fatigue on warehouse shifts?
Will the OR accept model-themed comments if the method is documented?

role.altitude: The HRBP moves from answering repeat questions and building Excel reports to being second line for escalated cases, coaching managers, and acting on site-level signals with the OR.
reach: People analytics: own the survey and grievance data in Power BI with the people analyst
Learning: turn manager guidance into Studytube modules with L&D
Works council: prepare consent requests for HR AI tools with the HR director
skills_to_grow: Curating and maintaining an approved policy library
Reading Power BI dashboards and setting anonymity thresholds
Writing WOR consent requests and AI Act transparency notices
Reviewing model drafts and comment themes critically
role.ambitious_version: A Teams HR front door for every manager and team lead on three sites, a confidential complaint route that also covers flex workers, and quarterly site satisfaction reviews linked to verzuim and 90-day retention, with the three HRBPs working as second line on cases that need judgement.
